title: 父と母のいる暮らし
lead: お父さん・お母さんの家事・仕事・送り迎えなどの場面12点です。父の日・母の日のカードや、家庭向けの資料に使えます。
subject_en: Faceless style (no facial features at all, smooth oval face), flat simple shapes, each ONE parent figure with a small child or a household object, full body, centred, varied ages and skin tones. Outlines are closed and darker than the fill; light parts (snow, paper, white fur, plates) are warm cream (#FFF6E0) or tinted, never pure white. No letters, no text, no logos.
